_doc: Advisories explicitly accepted by review. Each entry needs a review_by date. CI fails if any entry is past its review date.

advisories.reason: Transitive via pptxgenjs@4.0.1 (image-size@^1.2.1, resolves 1.2.1/2.0.2). DoS via a crafted ICNS buffer causing an infinite loop in the ICNS parser. No patched version exists (first_patched_version: null as of 2026-08-29; latest 2.0.2 is still listed vulnerable). This plugin only feeds pptxgenjs images it generates/selects from client-data brand assets, never untrusted client-uploaded image bytes, so the DoS surface is not reachable here. Re-check on the next review date for an upstream fix; forcing an npm override to 2.0.2 does not resolve this (still in the vulnerable range) and downgrading pptxgenjs to 1.1.5 (npm audit fix --force) is a larger breaking change than the risk warrants.

Transitive via pptxgenjs@4.0.1 (image-size@^1.2.1, resolves 1.2.1/2.0.2). DoS via a crafted JXL/HEIF buffer causing an infinite loop in those parsers. No patched version exists (first_patched_version: null as of 2026-08-29). Same reasoning and mitigation as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr — no untrusted image input reaches pptxgenjs in this plugin.
